BRBC Monday Social Ride

Leawood, KS

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

BRBC Monday Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Leawood, KS. It meets every Monday, gather 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm, March–September, starting at Elite Cycling at Mission Farms. Expect about 15 miles, 15 mph average, 12 mph sweep.

About the BRBC Monday Social Ride group ride

A relaxed 15-mile loop through the neighborhoods around Mission Farms, good for recovery days and for beginners. A sweep rider holds 12 mph so nobody is left. The club's Saturday rides are faster: a 7:15 am coffee ride and a 9 am 40-mile drop ride with regroups.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
